meta.title: A saved eRFX draft: with lock_vendors_addition_in_event_creation Off, "RFQ" is not offered
gaps: Verify that the company setting lock_vendors_addition_in_event_creation is Off.
Select an unspecified draft and prove it is specifically an eRFX draft before checking its stage menu.
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: Verify that the company setting lock_vendors_addition_in_event_creation is Off.; Select an unspecified draft and prove it is specifically an eRFX draft before checking its stage menu.

steps.note: Open the Events list to reach the saved drafts.
Confirm the events list rendered successfully.
Open the Drafts tab as required by the case.
Open the first saved draft; a draft reopens on its create screen.
Open the Add Stages menu where the RFQ option would be offered.
Assert that RFQ is not offered in the draft's Add Stages menu.
